about: Generated by `python -m sho.data.v3.catalogue` from sho/data/multidomain/intents_v3.py (docs/design/intents-v3.md, approved 2026-09-26); do not edit. Loaded by sho.catalogue when SHO_CATALOGUE=v3.

when.resolver: none: {date, time, bound, to?} by parseWhen against the time of speech, Europe/Kyiv; the span keeps its preposition (intents-v3 §5.2)

order_number.resolver: search.query types=[order]; spoken «122», «номер 45», «sp 1999» → SP-0122 (zero-padded 4 digits with the SP- prefix)

money.resolver: none: {minor, currency} by the runtime's money reader («півтори тисячі», «1,5к», «50 баксів»); replaces the v2 `price` and `amount` spans, the param names stay (intents-v3 §5.1, §6b)

attr.resolver: the line's product variants: attrs are untyped value words, matched as a set (API v2 §4); replaces the v2 `variant` span (one v2 variant span is one attr)

search_text.resolver: passed verbatim as the list/search query

new_name.resolver: none: the name of the record being created

rename_to.resolver: none: the new name of an existing record

edrpou.resolver: none (8 digits ЄДРПОУ or 10 digits РНОКПП)

document_ref.resolver: search.query types=[document]; spoken «рахунок 98», «накладна 17» → 0098 (zero-padded 4 digits), narrowed by document_type when spoken

expires.resolver: app: days:N or date:MM-DD → expiresAt, Europe/Kyiv end of day

count.resolver: none: a small integer; replaces the v2 `max_uses` span, the param name stays

pick_text.resolver: app: matched against the rows the picker or list shows (customer, amount, date, number)

city.resolver: host: settlement search; the runtime's case-form stemmer gives a nominative guess

branch.resolver: none: {kind: branch|postomat|point, number} from the head word and the number

measure.resolver: none: weight in grams or dimensions [l, w, h] in cm (units.ts)

ttn.resolver: none: 14 digits → Nova Poshta, 3–5 digits → partial (a suffix the host matches); no checksum

category.resolver: host: matched against its expense or income categories

value_formats.period: an enum value, `range:MM-DD..MM-DD`, `range:YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD` (a spoken year, a numbered quarter or half-year, «9 місяців») or `last_days:N`; the head predicts `range`/`last_days` and the runtime reads the dates from the `period_span` span
value_formats.when: never an enum: the `when` span is read by the runtime

orders.list.note: kind page.summary; without any filter it is nav.orders

orders.count.note: kind aggregate; counts and totals (сума, виручка)

orders.get.note: one order: a number, or a description of one order (singular); several matches open the picker

orders.create.note: without customer and items it is nav.orders_new

orders.cancel.note: also «видали замовлення»: orders have no hard delete

customers.getCustomer.note: one named customer: «покажи клієнта Олена Савчук», «знайди клієнта Бойко»; D94: also found by a phone or an e-mail («знайди клієнта з номером 067 123 45 67», «чий це номер …», «клієнт з поштою …»): one match opens the record, several are candidates. A plural or a filter («знайди клієнтів з Києва», «клієнти групи VIP») is customers.listCustomers; «знайди X» with no type word is search.query

customers.updateCustomer.note: only the record spoken: open its edit form

customers.setGroup.note: two or more customers into one group («додай Альбіну, Шерлока і Оксану в групу оптові»); one card for the batch, one customers.updateCustomer {id, groupId} per customer on confirm; one customer is customers.updateCustomer (D58); after customers.createGroup «туди» fills group by ref_previous

customers.updateGroup.note: only the record spoken: open its edit form

customers.updateCounterparty.note: only the record spoken: open its edit form

catalog.getProduct.note: also the price of one product

catalog.updateProduct.note: only the record spoken: open its edit form

catalog.archiveProduct.note: also «видали товар»: products have no hard delete

catalog.archiveVariant.note: also «видали варіант»: variants have no hard delete

pricing.updatePriceList.note: only the record spoken: open its edit form

documents.list.note: customer, period and signing_status filters need a Shozee change to documents.list (owner, 2026-09-22); trained ahead

documents.cancel.note: also «видали рахунок / накладну / документ»: documents have no hard delete

invites.create.note: no parameters is fine: the card is the new-invite form (there is no nav.invites_new)

search.query.note: a stock question («чи є у нас брауні») has search_type product (D45); a bare customer name with no type word («покажи альбіна») is customers.getCustomer, not a search (D16)

ui.pick.note: answers an open picker, or picks from the list on screen; «друге», «останнє», «оксани», «те що на 500 грн»

ui.reject.note: closes the open card or picker: «ні», «не треба», «відміна», a bare «скасуй»

ui.refine.note: refines the previous read command: a fragment «а за минулий», «а за місяць», «а для Олега», «а тільки нові», «а по безналу»; the runtime merges it into the previous command (every param its schema has is replaced; `period: previous` steps its unit back); no previous read command → the card asks

none_kinds: small talk, a greeting or thanks
a request for another app (music, weather, taxi, translate, timer)
a half sentence, a false start or an unclear mumble
a question about the app itself or how to do something in it
background speech in the shop: a customer asking a price, a phone call, TV, talk to a colleague; it may name products, numbers and customers
a plain statement about a customer, product or colleague that is not a command
analytics the app cannot answer: a forecast, the best employee
a vague reply that is neither yes, no nor a choice («не знаю», «подумаю», «хм, а що там»)
moving an order back to an earlier status
